## Ray traversal (closest hit)

2000000 SAR-geometry rays (35 deg incidence from 693 km, clipped to the scene).

| Structure | Threads | Mrays/s |
|---|---|---|
| Binary BVH, object median | 1 | 0.88 |
| Binary BVH, SAH | 1 | 0.91 |
| 4-wide BVH (SSE), SAH | 1 | 1.45 |
| Binary BVH, SAH, coherent order | 1 | 2.58 |
| 4-wide BVH (SSE), SAH, coherent order | 1 | 5.53 |

Hit rate: 98.7%. Random order is the cache-hostile worst case; the renderer traces in coherent order.
